data.name: Record of Ragnarok (Shuumatsu no Valkyrie)
data.description:
The work narrates the last battle between humans and gods to decide the fate of the human race. To make the work, the authors were inspired a little by the divinities of the different religions of the world and by Many historical characters.

Characters:

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters. She rose up against the gods in an attempt to save humanity and is the series' continuing main protagonist, as she was the one who chose the Best and most powerful warriors of mankind In Ragnarok to face the strongest gods and kill them.

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, passion and procreation. The goddess was so displeased with mankind's environmental pollution, animal slaughter, and penchant for conflict that she voted So to the destruction of mankind in all the counsels of God.

Lü Bu: The Flying General. The character hails from Ancient China and was a notable warlord during the Three Kingdoms period, considered by many to be the strongest warrior in history.

Lü Bu is A fearless, daring and determined warrior, and like Thor, he takes great pleasure in fighting. During his lifetime, he realized that no one in the mortal world could defeat him, Being then seen as the worst and most barbaric warrior. Similar to Thor, he is a man of few words speaking only when absolutely necessary or in combat.

Second, Adam who is the representative of humans in the second round of Ragnarok, going against Zeus and being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok. The character is the progenitor of Humanity, being the first human to exist and created in the image and likeness of the gods.

Adam is calm, collected and carefree, often speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present – he has even shown himself to be disrespectful at times in the anime. He was also confident in his capabilities. It is later revealed that he holds no grudge against the heavens and the gods, even though in his story he has the problem with the Serpent who framed Eve, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. Adam is also relentless in defending those he holds dear, mercilessly bringing down the Serpent and brutally attacking his creators.

Adam's desire to protect his descendants was so intense that his battle with Zeus was epic!

Kojiro Sasaki is the representative of the humans in the third round of Ragnarok, going against the god Poseidon.

The famous swordsman comes from feudal Japan, and there is a duality to his references: he is still considered by many as “the strongest swordsman of mankind”, but also as “The greatest loser in history”.

Since his youth, Kojiro has been a carefree, confident, and mostly lazy individual. However, he can be very diligent and hardworking at times, such as when he constantly fought trying to defeat several swordsmen and, through hard and rigorous training, bested them in due time. He holds great respect for the swordsmen he has fought, not wanting to let himself be lost to shame their names and even showing the utmost gratitude for molding him into the person he is today, especially by defeating Poseidon.

Fourth: Jack the Ripper is the humans' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok, facing off against Hercules. Jack was an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

We often see Jack have the disposition of a typical British gentleman, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions, but he is a true sadist and wrapped in malice and evil, killing people because he considers the fear they feel before death absolutely beautiful.

Born as Tarōkochi Seki, Raiden Tameemon is the humans' representative in the fifth round of Ragnarok, going up against the god Shiva.

Raiden was a famous Japanese sumo wrestler and was known for having the strongest muscles in history. The character Göll described Raiden as the "incarnation of desire", being shown as a perverted man when he is around beautiful women.

The warrior is serious about his battle with the god Shiva, and has disregarded the speeches about fun in fights made by the deity. His motivation for participating in the battle was to free men from the control of the gods.

In all, there are six battles and Buddha is the last representative of humans, going against Zerofuku, despite initially being listed as a representative of the gods. Buddha is a prominent deity and leader of the Buddhist Pantheon, being the founder of Buddhism, one of the Four Sages. He is also one of the few divine beings, alongside Hercules and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of destroying humanity. Also, he is one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok!

Previously, the Buddha was a human being by the name of Siddhartha Gautama and a famous philosophical figure from ancient Nepal, before attaining enlightenment and finally ascending to godhood.

Buddha has a laid-back attitude and is quite confident in his power as seen when he challenged the Seven Lucky Gods and Loki alone. His confidence is most evident when he says he doesn't mind challenging Zeus, so you can tell he's also bold and outgoing. He is extremely brave, he doesn't want to let anyone pressure him, regardless of whether he is a god or a human, saying that only he can move. He also shows great disrespect towards his fellow gods, and in contrast has an intense drive to protect humanity.

Firstly, regarding the gods: Thor, the representative of the gods in the first round of Ragnarok, fighting Lü Bu and being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok.

Thor is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, being the Norse God of Thunder, and is also often considered the Strongest God and Warrior of the Nords. Similar to Lü Bu, the god is a battle freak and has a keen interest in fighting; especially with worthy opponents. Furthermore, he just shows happiness and joy in combat by showing off his best smile in the fight. Thor is also one of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat.

Now it's about Zeus, the representative of the gods in the second round of Ragnarok and who fights against Adam, also being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok. Zeus is the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon, he is also the President of the Council of the Gods and referred to as the Father God of the Cosmos.

When addressing the other gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative. Like most gods, the character keeps expecting the gods to win battles and seething with rage when they lose to humans. E is an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts. Furthermore, he can be very proud and arrogant, declaring himself the "Father God of the Cosmos" and confidently remarking that he would destroy Adam.

And then we come to Kojiro Sasaki's opponent, who is the god Poseidon. Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek pantheon, being the God of the Seas, often referred to as the most fearsome god. The god is a fearsome, arrogant, and cold-hearted individual, shown when he mercilessly killed his older brother, Adamas. Like many other gods, the character despises humanity and considers them nothing but filth.

The representative of the gods in the fourth battle and fighting Jack is Hercules, also known as Hercules and also being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok.

Hercules is a deity of the Greek Pantheon, being the God of Fortitude. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with the Buddha and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity. Previously, Hercules was a human named Alcides and ascended to godhood by drinking Ambrosia.

Hercules is considered the fairest being among the gods, accentuated by his actions, ideology, judgment, and his opposition to the end of Humanity. Heracles is a person of honor and dignity as well, saying that despite not supporting the destruction of mankind, he would still do his best on his rounds in Ragnarok. He also admires those he sees with strength in his eyes, even if it's someone he loathes, like Jack the Ripper.

Shiva is the representative of the Gods in the fifth battle, being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok and fighting Raiden Tameemon. Being the leader of the Hindu Pantheon, He is considered to be the strongest God of Destruction in Heaven among all other Gods.

The god is presented as carefree, proud and powerful. However, he showed violent tendencies, even against Zeus himself, but stood his ground towards his father. The god Vishnu comments that Shiva is always reckless; Rudra stating that although Shiva is nicer than anyone, once he gets into a fight he likes to talk his fist more than anyone else.

And finally, Zerofuku is the representative of the Gods in the sixth round of Ragnarok, going against Buddha and taking the place of Bishamonten.

Zerofuku is a deity of the Japanese Pantheon, being the God of Misfortune and is also the fusion of the Seven Lucky Gods, being their original form before they separated in the past. The name “Zerofuku” means “zero luck”, but we can also interpret it as “misfortune”.

Originally, the character was a kind-hearted deity who bestowed good fortune on those around him, absorbing all their misfortune. One day everything changed when Zerofuku witnessed the true depraved nature of humanity. It all came to his head when Buddha did a better job of spreading happiness than he did, filling him with jealousy. At first he simply ran away and wept in a river over the perceived humiliation of the Buddha. Over time, the god grew angry and hateful towards humanity, and resolved to destroy them, but he still seems to care about humanity to some extent, avoiding killing a mother and her child by splitting himself into the "Seven Lucky Gods". .

It can be inferred that he has a significant amount of bloodlust for individuals he finds disgusting. Zerofuku is also childish and throws tantrums at things he hates.

Qin Shi Huang is the representative of Humanity in the seventh round of Ragnarok, being one of the most powerful characters in Record Of Ragnarok and facing Hades. His real name is "Ying Zheng" (嬴政えいせい), with Qin Shi Huang or "Shi Huang Di" (秦し始こう皇てい) being a title literally meaning "First Emperor of Qin". He is the founder of the Qin Dynasty and the first emperor to unify China, widely considered the greatest emperor in all of Chinese history.

The character is shown to be extremely confident in himself, as he entered the area of the Gods and sat in Hades' chair. In addition, he is also extremely proud of his position as Emperor, is quite fearless and daring, attacking Ares without being afraid of the God and yet ignoring him as if he were nothing.

Hades is the representative of the Gods in the seventh round of Ragnarok, replacing Buda after his betrayal in the previous round, facing Qin Shi Huang. He is a prominent deity within the Greek Pantheon, being the "King of the Netherworld". Hades is also famous as “The God whom other gods trust the most”.

Hades appears to be a very sophisticated and quiet individual, while also being a highly respected and feared god among the Greek pantheon, as seen when Ares immediately yields his seat to him at his behest and when all the gods become aware of him entering the arena.

Nikola Tesla is Humanity's representative in the eighth round of Ragnarok, facing Beelzebub. Known as the “Ultimate Mad Scientist of His Time”, Tesla is one of the most famous and renowned scientists of all time, due to his inventions and discoveries that changed the world forever.

Beelzebub is the representative of the Gods in the eighth round of Ragnarok, facing Nikola Tesla. The character is a prominent deity in the Philistine Pantheon and the Abrahamic Pantheon. He is known by several titles. For humans, for example, he is commonly the "Lord of the Flies". To the gods, “Anathema”, which indicates that he is the one cursed by Satan.

Other gods that will appear in Shuumatsu no Valkyrie:

Loki, the Norse god of trickery.

Apollo, Greek god of the sun and music.

Susano'o no Mikoto, Japanese god of the seas.

Anubis, the Egyptian god of the dead.

Odin, supreme Norse god.
Ragnarok has begun, will you save humanity?

As the Shuumatsu no Valkyrie manga progresses I will bring updates in the chat.
